fields.description: The Guardian XO is Sarcos Robotics' full-body, battery-powered industrial exoskeleton. fields.description: Ozmo is Skyline Robotics' robotic facade-cleaning system for building glass. fields.description: Shelfobot is Tokinomo's shelf-mounted advertising robot. A motion sensor detects nearby shoppers, a motorized swing arm moves the displayed product, and LED lighting and custom audio support the interaction. Each unit connects over Wi-Fi with an embedded SIM and is managed through a cloud campaign platform and a mobile app; campaign audio, volume and motion patterns can be changed remotely. The manufacturer says the robot carries up to 1.5 kg (1.2 kg recommended) and runs about seven days on its custom battery, which charges fully in 12 hours. It is designed for retail shelves and open or closed refrigerated cases. No numeric price, mass, dimensions, speed, IP rating or release date is published.

body-scope-check.versionScopes: Guardian XO is one wearable exoskeleton; Guardian XT is a separate teleoperated upper-body system and its 200 lb figure is not merged into the XO. Ozmo is one facade-cleaning robot, not the Skyline company or its operator network. Mako 4 is one surgical platform; Mako Total Hip, Total Knee, Partial Knee, Spine and Shoulder are applications on that system, not separate robots. SY-HR08E is one soft glove system; the SY-HR06E, SY-HR03E, SY-HRC15 and SY-HR10A are separate products. Rosie is one vacuum robot; the three batteries in the kit are consumables, not three robots. Shelfobot is one shelf display robot; Visibubble is a separate product. ROSA Knee with OptimiZe is one knee system; Persona is an implant brand, not a robot.
body-scope-check.priceScopes: No reviewed manufacturer page publishes a numeric Guardian XO, Ozmo, Mako 4, SY-HR08E, Shelfobot or ROSA Knee price. Rosie lists a 7,999.99 USD purchase option and a 1,249 USD annual renewal. The Guardian XO was a development program, not a listed commercial product.
body-scope-check.weightScopes: Rosie publishes 24 lb; the catalog 18 lb value conflicts and remains visible. Tokinomo publishes a 1.5 kg payload, not robot mass. No Guardian XO suit mass, Ozmo mass, Mako 4 mass, SY-HR08E mass or ROSA mass is published.
body-scope-check.sizeScopes: Rosie publishes 12.7 x 20.7 x 8.5 in. No Guardian XO, Ozmo, Mako 4, SY-HR08E, Shelfobot or ROSA dimensions are published. Mako reach and surgical workspace are not overall system dimensions.
body-scope-check.payloadScopes: The Guardian XO page publishes up to 200 lb (90 kg) lift and manipulation capacity. Shelfobot publishes 1.5 kg maximum and 1.2 kg recommended. Rosie publishes no payload mass; brush width and suction are cleaning specifications, not a load rating. No Ozmo, Mako 4, SY-HR08E or ROSA payload is published.
body-scope-check.enduranceScopes: Rosie publishes 90/135/180 minutes by mode and a 12 V, 188.7 Wh battery. Shelfobot publishes about seven days on its custom battery. Guardian XO describes hot-swappable batteries and near-continuous operation without a runtime. No Ozmo, Mako 4, SY-HR08E or ROSA battery endurance is published.
body-scope-check.autonomyScopes: Ozmo is a facade-cleaning robot supervised from a building maintenance unit; the operator can stop it at any time. Guardian XO is operator-worn and operator-directed, not self-navigating. Mako 4 and ROSA Knee are surgeon-controlled surgical arms. SY-HR08E is a therapist-supervised rehabilitation glove. Rosie navigates with lidar and a 3D depth camera without pre-mapping. Shelfobot reacts to shoppers but does not navigate. These are manufacturer descriptions, not independent safety certification.
body-scope-check.listingScopes: The roboticsdir and buyandrentrobots listings name products and companies; they do not establish prices, current stock, delivered fleets or independent performance.
